chip.description: Eight-voice BRR-ADPCM sample player of the SNES with per-voice ADSR envelopes, pitch modulation, noise, an 8-tap FIR echo unit and stereo panning, reading samples from the S-SMP address space.
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/s_dsp.cpp in MAME 0.288, device full name "Nintendo/Sony S-DSP", which implements BRR decoding, per-voice ADSR envelope states, a noise generator, pitch modulation and an FIR echo buffer. Filed sound-pcm under taxonomy A2 (fixed-silicon sample replay); Q2 does not fire because the part runs no microcode. Manufacturer recorded as Sony for the same reason as the S-SMP row.
